question: Should ClawSweeper treat Telegram, Discord, and web UI chat as the only schema-valid, copyable OpenClaw Mantis proof recommendation lanes for now?
rationale: The code and tests are internally aligned, but the PR intentionally changes the public Mantis scenario contract and bot-proof routing behavior for unsupported proof surfaces, which is a maintainer scope decision.

options.title: Accept the scoped Mantis contract
options.body: Merge this direction with Mantis limited to Telegram, Discord, and web UI chat proof while unsupported surfaces use non-Mantis proof guidance.

options.title: Keep broader scenarios public
options.body: Ask for a branch update that preserves Slack desktop or generic visual scenarios until maintainers deprecate or replace them explicitly.

options.title: Pause for proof policy work
options.body: Keep the PR open until the broader proof-attestation discussion decides which proof workers and lanes should own each surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped Mantis contract
recommendation.body: Merge this direction with Mantis limited to Telegram, Discord, and web UI chat proof while unsupported surfaces use non-Mantis proof guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa introduced the bot-owned proof lane and Mantis dispatch scoping that this PR changes.
